subject: add index: add backfill task meta version (#61430)
summary: Adds `BackfillTaskMeta.Version` and updates global-sort add-index backfill to use distributed `task.ID` (instead of DDL `job.ID`) as the external-storage prefix, aligning data/meta locations under `taskID/...`. Cleanup now always removes `taskID`-prefixed artifacts and additionally removes legacy `jobID`-prefixed artifacts only for old (version0) task metas.
